text:
nina_pm: Heads-up — quick async check on OptKit delivery. We're at the milestone where quant recs + batching defaults land in runtime. Need clear owners for: quant profiles, batching/caching defaults, CR for regression tests. Can owners call dibs?

alex_dev: I'll pick up batching/caching defaults. Will sketch default policy by EOD. Any constraints? @maria_ml

maria_ml: I'll own quantization recommendations (int8 / q4o) and regen perf numbers. Have a draft with numbers, pushing to PR later today. Need target accuracy regressions thresholds from PM.

nina_pm: target thresholds: <=1% relative metric delta on eval set OR manual sign-off. I'll post eval links.

cheng_platform: I'll take CRs and rollout plan on runtime side. Need config knob naming. Prefer `optkit.batch.policy` and `optkit.quant.profile`.

alex_dev: cool. tentative policy snippet:
```yaml
optkit:
  batch:
    policy: "latency_priority"
    max_tokens: 1024
    max_wait_ms: 15
  cache:
    prefix_kv: true
    ttl_seconds: 60
```
Happy to iterate.

maria_ml: quick numbers: q4o drops perf 3.2% on LLM-Eval; int8 drops 0.9%. Will attach CSV in PR. Plan: recommend q4o for cost-sensitive low-criticality routes, int8 for high-quality routes.

sam_sre: FYI deploy-bot: scheduled canary for dedicated next Tue 07:00 UTC. @cheng_platform make sure fallback routes included.

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: optkit/quant-rollout -> dedicated-pool-3 -> 2026-03-24T07:00Z. Notified: #eng-sre #eng-platform

nina_pm: regression alerting: add eval set to release pipeline; if metric delta > 1% post-rollout auto-revert. @alex_dev can you add a canary flag in config?

alex_dev: yes — will add `optkit.canary.enabled` and `optkit.canary.thresholds.eval_delta` to config. PR by tomorrow morning.

maria_ml: also request: baseline cache hit rates. If cache hit < 30% for certain routes, recommend disabling to avoid extra mem pressure.

cheng_platform: noted. Also need a compatibility table: model variants supported per quant profile. I'll create doc and ping model-onboarding.

nina_pm: blockers? dependencies?

alex_dev: blocked on a small API change in console for exposing batch knobs. Created ticket PLAT-1432.

maria_ml: need runner perf traces from eng-runtime to validate KV cache behavior. @cheng_platform can you share traces?

cheng_platform: will share S3 link with traces by EOD. Also leaving a note: watch out for long-tail lat spikes with large batch sizes.

devex-bot: Reminder: PR templates updated to include 'regression-eval' checklist — https://git.redwood/repo/pulls/template

nina_pm: Thanks all. Summary: owners — quant: maria_ml, batching/caching: alex_dev, runtime rollout: cheng_platform, SRE oversight: sam_sre. Next async update by Thu. :thumbsup:
